polls.description: Over 100 Baidu robotaxis simultaneously froze in traffic in Wuhan, creating a major autonomous vehicle crisis that stranded passengers and flooded police with emergency calls.
polls.question: Should cities pause robotaxi deployments after this mass failure?

cluster_stories.title: More than 100 Baidu robotaxis froze mid-traffic in Wuhan. The age of the mass fleet failure has arrived.
cluster_stories.summary: On Tuesday evening in Wuhan, more than 100 of Baidu’s Apollo Go robotaxis stopped moving. They did not pull over. They did not activate an emergency protocol. They simply froze, scattered across the city’s roads and elevated highways, some in the middle lane of ring roads with traffic streaming past on both sides. Passengers trapped […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: 100+ BAIDU ROBOTAXIS FREEZE MID-TRAFFIC... MASS FLEET FAILURE

cluster_stories.title: Baidu’s robotaxis froze in traffic, creating chaos
cluster_stories.summary: Numerous robotaxis operated by Chinese tech giant Baidu froze in a major city on Tuesday, reportedly trapping passengers inside, stranding them on highways, and causing at least one accident in snarled traffic. Police in Wuhan confirmed receiving multiple reports of Baidu's Apollo Go robotaxis stopping in the middle of streets and being unable to move. […]
cluster_stories.headline: BAIDU ROBOTAXIS FREEZE... Passengers Trapped in Traffic

cluster_stories.title: Robotaxi Outage in China Leaves Passengers Stranded on Highways
cluster_stories.summary: A suspected system failure froze Baidu’s robotaxis across Wuhan, trapping passengers and reportedly causing traffic disruptions and crashes.
cluster_stories.headline: BAIDU ROBOTAXIS FREEZE... PASSENGERS STRANDED

cluster_stories.title: Baidu Robotaxis Freeze in Wuhan, Sparking Flurry of Police Calls
cluster_stories.summary: A number of Baidu Inc.’s Apollo Go robotaxis suddenly stopped on the streets of China’s Wuhan city on Tuesday, leaving passengers stranded and raising concerns about the safety and reliability of autonomous driving technology.
cluster_stories.headline: BAIDU ROBOTAXIS FREEZE in Wuhan... Police Flooded with Calls

cluster_stories.title: Baidu robotaxi outage in Wuhan caused by 'system failure', police say
cluster_stories.summary: At least 100 Apollo Go vehicles were affected, a traffic police officer said in a ​video published by Shanghai-based news outlet The ⁠Paper. The ‌officer added that while the car doors could ​be opened, ​some passengers were hesitant to get out because ⁠of heavy traffic and called police for assistance.
cluster_stories.headline: BAIDU ROBOTAXIS BREAK DOWN... 100 Cars Stranded in Wuhan

cluster_stories.title: Mass robotaxi malfunction halts traffic in Chinese city
cluster_stories.summary: Baidu has not responded to a request for comment about the outage, which affected at least 100 cars.
cluster_stories.headline: MASS ROBOTAXI MALFUNCTION Halts Chinese City

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Seals $122 Billion Mega Funding Deal
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has reached a mega deal to raise $122 billion at an $852 billion valuation. Much of the capital comes from tech giants including Amazon, Nvidia and SoftBank. Bloomberg's Annabelle Droulers reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI RAISES MONSTER $122B AT $852B VALUATION

cluster_stories.title: Accelerating the next phase of AI

cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI RAISES $122 BILLION in Massive Funding Round
